rate_ppm.source_name: RevenueWA - Calculation: Payroll Tax Employer Guide
rate_ppm.note: 5.5% on taxable wages. Page last updated 2 June 2026.

annual.source_name: RevenueWA - Calculation: Payroll Tax Employer Guide

upper.source_name: RevenueWA - Calculation: Payroll Tax Employer Guide
upper.note: $7,500,000 upper threshold; no deduction at or above this.

tapering_value.source_name: RevenueWA - Calculation: Payroll Tax Employer Guide
tapering_value.note: TV = AT / (UT - AT) = 1,000,000 / 6,500,000, simplified to 2/13. Deduction reduces by $2 for every $13 of wages over the threshold.

basis.source_name: RevenueWA - Calculation: Payroll Tax Employer Guide
basis.note: Registration arises when monthly Australian taxable wages exceed $83,333 (from 1 July 2023).

flat_monthly_amount.source_name: RevenueWA - Calculation: Payroll Tax Employer Guide
flat_monthly_amount.note: $83,333 monthly Australian taxable wages registration threshold, from 1 July 2023.

by_days_employed.source_name: RevenueWA - Calculation: Payroll Tax Employer Guide
by_days_employed.note: 'The threshold can be apportioned if you don't pay wages for a whole financial year, become a member of a group or stop being a member of a group.'

by_share_of_au_wages.unsourced_reason: Not stated as a separate apportionment on this page. WA handles interstate wages inside the diminishing threshold, which is computed on Australia-wide wages, so a further share apportionment may not apply - but the page does not say so and this must not be inferred.

apportionment.note: The deductable amount is computed from Australia-wide wages and then applied against WA taxable wages: 'WA taxable wages - deductable amount x tax rate'.

surcharges.source_name: RevenueWA - Calculation: Payroll Tax Employer Guide
surcharges.note: The current rates table ('From 1 July 2023 -') carries no surcharge tiers. The >$100 million and >$1.5 billion tiers shown on the same page belong to the superseded 1 July 2020 - 30 June 2023 table.

contractor_exemptions.unsourced_reason: Exemption catalogue not retrieved in this pass.

monthly_threshold.unsourced_reason: Not stated. The published deductable-amount example ($969,231 from $1,200,000 of wages) is a whole dollar, consistent with whole-dollar rounding but not a stated rule.

deductible_amount.note: $1,000,000 - [($1,200,000 - $1,000,000) x 2/13] is printed as $969,231. The exact value is $969,230.77, so RevenueWA rounds the deductable amount to whole dollars.
